verdict: Meta delivering 125 leads; Google spend is paused on a tracking fix.
narrative: Over the last 28 days you received 125 leads at a blended cost of $23.12 per lead — but that number is skewed by a Google Ads tracking issue. Meta alone produced all 125 leads at $9.70 per lead, a healthy result; Google consumed $1,678 over the same window with zero conversions recorded because call events are not being captured correctly. Google spend has been pulled back while conversion tracking is repaired, which also explains the sharp dip in daily lead volume seen in the last few days of the window. Once tracking is restored and offline conversion import is live — targeted for end of August — Google will be back in full rotation and the blended cost per lead will reflect actual performance across both channels.
